findings.message: _impact_run_entry calls _impact_input three times sequentially, each forking a new jq process and re-reading the same ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS file; a single jq invocation extracting all three fields would cut the file-open and process-fork cost to one-third.

The success path now runs three sequential jq subprocesses over the same $impact_json string (one pre-existing .verdict extract, one new .missing|length for _missing_count, one new merge for _v2_impact) where a single jq invocation could extract verdict, missing length, and produce the merged object in one pass; absolute cost is small given the 600 s model-call budget but the redundancy is introduced by this change.
